notes.title: Patch Notes: V1.01
notes.notes:
Mage Tower Massacre Patch 1

Added new character bios to the extras page

New character art by Sayton!

Reduce fat fella collision sizes so they no longer get stuck in tight spaces

Slightly reduced player hurtbox size

Increased enemy projectile visibility with bigger sprites and a glowing trail for arrows

Several menu fixes for ultrawide displays

If you have a suggestion for an update or bugfix, please feel free to let me know!



Semper games,

-squid_lawyer
